items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I’m reminded of Calloway who eventually bought himself a rail car... And I just wondered if the Basie band ran into that... [INTERVIEWEE] I really didn’t notice anything like that.

ctx.x: Oh, no, no, no, no, no. That Jim Crow is directed against the blacks. Where, well for example, the bands that used to travel in the south had terrible trouble eating and finding places to stay. And I’m reminded of Calloway who eventually bought himself a rail car, which served as their home every place they went. And I just wondered if the Basie band ran into that, because I’ve never heard of any problem with the Basie band.
I really didn’t notice anything like that. It went over my head if it was there.
